items.title: Want Reliable Dividend Income? These 4 High-Yield Stocks Have Balance Sheets Lenders Still Trust
items.summary: When a dividend gets cut, lenders usually see trouble first. Four payers yielding above 5% span telecom, tobacco, real estate, and logistics, yet one of them runs a coverage cushion so thin that a weak peak season could test it.

items.title: 5 Defensive Dividend Stocks Yielding Up to 8.7% for Retirement Income
items.summary: Recessions punish shaky payouts, but some companies keep collecting cash anyway. From power lines to pipelines to pill bottles, five low-beta names promise income, yet one of them runs coverage tighter than the rest. Which one deserves your trust?

items.title: How These 4 Transportation Stocks Move the Economy
items.summary: Railroads and delivery giants did the heavy lifting for the economy this year. Their latest earnings show how.

items.title: After World War I, He Took A Job With A Parcel Delivery Company. He Bought Company Stock Every Year. He Retired From UPS In 1952 And Said He Never Made More Than $14,000 A Year. 39 Years Later Theodore Johnson’s Fortune Was An Estimated $70 Million
items.summary: Theodore Johnson built a fortune on a modest salary with one simple habit, but the same strategy has wrecked workers at Enron and Lehman. Here is what his story teaches, and the danger hidden inside it.

items.title: His Former Employer Will Pay a $1.64 Dividend in December. His 401(k) Has $1,640 Riding on It, but That Doesn’t Mean a Check Is Coming
items.summary: A dividend can pad your 401(k) balance without ever reaching your bank account. Before a retiree touches his old employer's stock, a hidden tax choice and a few plan rules could decide how much of it he actually keeps.

items.title: Bonds Now Pay More Than Stocks. Is 60/40 Back?
items.summary: Part of our series on building a mix that lasts. Start here: is 60/40 dead.
